subject: camp
prompt:

Seamless camp ground tileset, exactly 16 square tiles in gapless 4x4 grid. Use uniform logical cell dimensions. No visible grid, borders or labels. True transparent PNG except ground tiles which must be opaque. Keep rice-paper grain inside painted shapes only; completely transparent empty space, no paper backdrop or matte. Original designs only, no imitation, no watermark or logo.  Target production game sprites, fixed top-left light.
